Chapter 440: Chapter 11 The Invincibles of the Eighth Layer (Please Subscribe)_2

And currently, Lin Yuan had only absorbed the first type of scarlet-red liquid.

There were still six kinds of differently colored liquids waiting for him.

“Now my inner world has reached a circumference of two million two hundred thousand miles, which is 3.1 times the initial circumference of seven hundred thousand miles…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The further along he got, the smaller the margin of improvement became.

Lin Yuan estimated that the first scarlet-red liquid would boost his physical body and inner world up to a maximum of 3.33 times.

...

Once he had fully absorbed this scarlet-red liquid, Lin Yuan started to absorb the next kind, the orange liquid.

“3.33 times?”

Lin Yuan fell into contemplation; he was very familiar with this number.

One of the prerequisites to becoming a regular member of the Magic Jade Tower was the understanding of three thousand three hundred thirty-three evolutionary paths.

The Door to the Myriad Realms initially accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force at a rate of three hundred thirty-three days.

Both the Magic Jade Tower and the Door to the Myriad Realms had mysterious origins, especially the Door to the Myriad Realms, which easily sent Lin Yuan to the worlds of other dimensional planes.

In his weaker hours, Lin Yuan didn’t think much of it.

But as his strength increased and his grasp over the Space Rules deepened, he increasingly realized how terrifying such a method was. Even a Supreme Being wouldn’t be able to create a passageway to other dimensional planes, right?

“Continue, continue.”

“Let’s see what kind of improvement the following orange-yellow liquid has after I’ve completely absorbed the scarlet-red liquid.”

Lin Yuan rested for a while and then resumed absorbing the scarlet-red liquid.

In addition, Lin Yuan did not neglect to perfect the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, nor the contemplation of the Space Rules Model.

Everything was proceeding in an orderly fashion; almost every day that passed, Lin Yuan’s strength increased by a notch.

The expansion of a single mile in his inner world could bring a considerable increase to an Eighth Layer Evolver, let alone the fact that Lin Yuan’s inner world was expanding at a rate far exceeding a mile every day?

…..

Several months later.

The Milky Way Main Star welcomed a visitor.

“Hahaha, you’re Chikun’s little disciple? Impressive.” Inside the palace, Lin Yuan and a bald man in a white robe faced each other as they sat.

This bald man in a white robe exuded an aura of brightness and sanctity with every move, causing an instinctive feeling of closeness and fondness in others.

“White Light Star Master, if you put it that way, I’ll be a little embarrassed,” Lin Yuan said with a smile.

The White Light Star Master before him was an old Eighth Rank Peak powerhouse of the human civilization and a good friend of Chikun Star Lord.

Although the White Light Star Master was not invincible at the Eighth Rank, his strength was absolutely at the peak of the Eighth Rank.

In terms of the comprehension of Space Rules, he was almost no weaker than the Chikun Starlord.

It was only because he hadn’t comprehended a certain Cosmic Force that he was somewhat inferior to Chikun Starlord.

An invincible Eighth Layer powerhouse was essentially still in the fourth stage of the Eighth Layer.

The only difference was that they had comprehended a certain Cosmic Force that substantially increased their combat power, elevating them above the Eighth Layer, and even giving them the ability to save their lives in front of Ninth Rank Evolvers.

“This is the Thunderous Heart you asked for.” The White Light Star Master looked at Lin Yuan with a cheerful smile and then threw out a heart completely composed of thunder that seemed to beat.

The Thunderous Heart was a rare treasure from an Eight-Star Universe and could be regarded as a top-quality item among the Eight-Star treasures.

As Lin Yuan’s inner world expanded rapidly, it needed such cosmic treasures for refinement. He had learned from his teacher, Chikun Starlord, that the White Light Star Master had recently acquired this ‘Thunderous Heart’, prompting Lin Yuan to initiate contact with the latter for a trade.

It happened that the White Light Star Master was returning from one of the Battlefields of Different Races and passing by the Milky Way Star Region, so he took the opportunity to deliver it himself.

“Thank you, White Light Star Master.”

Lin Yuan immediately took out twelve thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

As a top-quality Eight-Star Universe rare treasure, the Thunderous Heart often had no fixed market price but traded between ten thousand and twenty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

That the White Light Star Master was willing to make the trade for twelve thousand Cubic Universe Crystals was clearly due to regard for the face of Chikun Starlord.

“Then the trade is complete.”

The White Light Star Master accepted the Cosmic Crystals and took another look at Lin Yuan, “What path do you plan to take next? Comprehend a Cosmic Force and become an invincible at Eighth Rank?”

“Invincible at the Eighth Rank?”

“That’s too hard,” Lin Yuan said, slightly startled and shaking his head.

Whether it was human civilization, other Peak Clans, or powerful ordinary clans, they all had powerhouses at the level of invincibility in the Eighth Rank.

But to this day, no clan had succeeded in outlining a specific method to become invincible at the Eighth Rank.

Each invincible Eighth Rank Evolver was unique, and the Cosmic Forces they comprehended were all different.

“It’s indeed very difficult to become an invincible at the Eighth Rank.”

“Many Eighth Layer Evolvers haven’t comprehended any Cosmic Force even until they advance to the Ninth Rank.”

The White Light Star Master nodded.

Using human civilization as an example, it might take thousands of Eighth Layer Evolvers to produce just one invincible at the Eighth Rank.

To become an invincible is also a matter of luck.

“It’s difficult for other Evolvers, but for you…”

A trace of strangeness emerged on the face of the White Light Star Master. Lin Yuan’s talent was absolutely the most terrifying he had ever seen.

Under a hundred years of age, he had not only become an Eighth Rank Evolver.

But he had also single-handedly cleansed the Milky Way Star Region, eradicating all those powerful special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers?

To accomplish this, one would need at least the combat power of an Evolver at the peak of the Eighth Rank.

This was simply freakish.

The White Light Star Master didn’t even know how to describe Lin Yuan.

But one thing was certain.

The term “Eighth Layer Invincible,” as it applied to other Evolvers,

might just be a matter of time in front of Lin Yuan?

After he had sent away the White Light Star Master,

Lin Yuan fell into deep thought.

In recent times, he had also been contemplating how to become Eighth Order Invincible.

But he hadn’t come up with any results. The Cosmic Force that each Evolver at the Eighth Layer Invincible stage had mastered had been gained through chance and could not be replicated.

If Lin Yuan wanted to become Eighth Order Invincible, he would have to comprehend his own type of Cosmic Force.

But that was easier said than done.

“Take it slow,”

“There’s no need to target becoming Eighth Order Invincible.”

“It would be great to reach that level, but if I can’t, I’ll just push directly for the Ninth Rank.”

Lin Yuan had thought it through clearly.

No matter how strong an Eighth Order Invincible was, they only had a chance of survival in front of a Ninth Rank Evolver, and clearly, the former was far inferior to the latter.

Besides,

Lin Yuan’s inability to comprehend a type of Cosmic Force didn’t mean he couldn’t become Eighth Order Invincible.

According to Lin Yuan’s estimation, he just needed to expand his Inner World to a circumference of tens of millions of miles; even without using Cosmic Force, his true combat power wouldn’t be inferior to an Eighth Order Invincible.

…

Outside the Milky Way Star Region,

on a desolate planet.

There were five figures standing quietly.

These five figures, with completely concealed auras, were subtly in harmony with the surrounding cosmos and stars, and they were unmistakably five Eighth Order Invincible beings.

Hum.

A consciousness projection descended.

A shadow of an insect nest, larger than the planet itself, appeared faintly visible.

“Your Eminence,”

The five Eighth Order Invincible beings slightly bowed towards the shadow of the insect nest upon seeing it.

As Eighth Order Invincible beings, even when encountering a Ninth Rank Evolver, such reverence was unnecessary, for Evolvers at the peak of the Eighth Rank usually had means to save their lives in the presence of a Ninth Rank.

But the insect nest shadow in front of them was a great existence of the Insect Race, towering above the Ninth Rank.

“Your target this time, is the Galaxy Master, that peerless genius of human civilization.”

The insect nest shadow emitted a mental fluctuation, its gaze sweeping over the five Eighth Order Invincible beings.

Among the peak clans, there was an unwritten understanding to avoid deploying Ninth Rank or higher beings, whether on battlefields or elsewhere, as much as possible.

Even if it was to assassinate the Galaxy Master, a peerless genius of the human civilization, they would not break this understanding.

The Insect Race had previously broken this understanding because a body of a Supreme Being from outside the world had drifted in.

It contained an Evolution Path that had no ultimate end.

There was hope to add another Supreme Being (Matriarch) to the Insect Race.

So, the Insect Race had directly overturned the table.

But the Galaxy Master? The Galaxy Master was indeed a peerless genius of the human civilization, but could he eventually become a Supreme Being?

The likelihood was that he could not.

To the Insect Race, assassinating the Galaxy Master was merely an effort to reduce future losses on the battlefield.

“Your Eminence, that Galaxy Master has only newly ascended to the Eighth Rank. Even if he possesses the combat power of an Eighth Order Invincible, one of us should suffice. Why the need for five to join forces?”

The Eighth Order Invincible on the far left asked.

“Newly advanced to the Eighth Rank?”

The insect nest shadow glanced at this Eighth Order Invincible, a hint of ridicule flashing in its eyes.
